newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks shares rise on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Banks shares rise on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: All three bank shares rose on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
Banque Audi rose to $20 from Monday's $19.625, Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce reached $15 from $14.75 and Bank of Beirut rose to $3.25 from $3.125.
Among the other five listed companies, Ciments Libanais rose to $1.28125 from $1.25 but the three other industrials and real estate company Solidere were unchanged.
